SDN.note: Nothing on AI harm rules or an authority mandate over harms.
Lab serves students and researchers, not government administration.
No sectoral public system AI tool stated.

facts.fact: SUNA reports Sudan's Data and AI Authority is building a shared central AI laboratory hosted inside Sudan and able to run offline, for about 100 simultaneous users and medium-sized models on local data, in final fit-out with operation expected within about three months.

systems.owner: Data and Artificial Intelligence Authority, Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications
